basis.governing_question: How should Atlas Logistics design and pilot a digital freight-matching platform for small shippers in Iberia?

phases.name: Design
phases.objective_one_line: Define the platform blueprint and pilot plan for small shippers in Iberia, tested against customer and market evidence.

gate.label: Go/no-go on pilot
gate.decision: Do we go ahead with the pilot on this blueprint and pilot plan?

phases.name: Pilot
phases.objective_one_line: Build a first version, launch it to a small group of shippers, and test it against 200 active shippers.

gate.label: Go/no-go on scale-up
gate.decision: Do we scale up the platform beyond the pilot on this business case?

workstreams.name: Platform hypotheses
workstreams.answers: Which assumptions about the platform and its small-shipper customers must hold for the pilot to work?
activities: Interview the CEO, CTO and Head of Sales on platform goals
Review existing documents and operational data
Draft hypotheses for each blueprint component

workstreams.name: Shipper and market evidence
workstreams.answers: What do small shippers and the Iberian freight market show about each hypothesis?
activities: Interview small shippers about how they book freight today
Analyze competing offers from public documents
Build a wireframe prototype and test it with shippers

deliverables.name: Customer and market evidence on the hypotheses

workstreams.name: Blueprint and pilot plan
workstreams.answers: What is the blueprint of the platform, and how will the pilot be run to reach 200 active shippers?
activities: Consolidate tested hypotheses into the platform blueprint
Plan the pilot: target group, KPIs, launch steps
Prepare the go/no-go case for the pilot decision

deliverables.name: Detailed plan for the pilot phase

workstreams.name: Pilot KPIs and tracking
workstreams.answers: How will the pilot's progress toward 200 active shippers be defined, agreed and tracked?
activities: Agree pilot KPIs with the CEO, CTO and Head of Sales
Track active shippers and usage from platform data
Report pilot results to the steering group

deliverables.name: Pilot KPIs agreed with CEO, CTO and Head of Sales

workstreams.name: Target shipper group
workstreams.answers: Which small shippers in Iberia should join the first pilot group?
activities: Screen small shippers by size and freight needs
Interview shortlisted shippers on willingness to join
Agree the first target group with the Head of Sales

deliverables.name: First pilot target group of small shippers

workstreams.name: Platform build and launch
workstreams.answers: What does it take to build, launch and grow a first working version with real shippers?
activities: Build the first version from the pilot plan
Onboard shippers from the target group in steps
Collect shipper feedback and fix issues in each release

deliverables.name: First version launched to a small group of shippers
Platform open to the full pilot shipper group

workstreams.name: Scale-up business case
workstreams.answers: What would scaling the platform beyond the pilot require and return, given the pilot results?
activities: Compare pilot results with the 200 active shippers goal
Model scale-up options from pilot data
Draft the business case, implementation plan and roadmap

deliverables.name: Scale-up options and economics from pilot data
Business case with implementation plan and roadmap

events.label: Kick-off
events.purpose: Align on goals, scope and plan of work
events.decision: Do we confirm the goals, scope and way of working for the engagement?
agenda: Present the plan of work, phases and steering meetings
Align on the 200 active shippers success criterion
Confirm access to people, documents and data

events.label: Workshop 1: first findings
events.purpose: Review first findings and set the direction
events.decision: Do we confirm the direction for the blueprint and pilot plan?
agenda: Present the hypotheses and the evidence collected so far
Discuss which hypotheses hold and which need rework
Confirm the direction for the blueprint and pilot plan

events.label: Go/no-go on pilot
events.purpose: Decide whether to start the pilot
events.decision: Do we go ahead with the pilot on this blueprint and pilot plan?
agenda: Present the blueprint with tested hypotheses
Review the wireframe prototype and the detailed pilot plan
Decide whether to go ahead with the pilot

events.label: Workshop 2: pilot readiness
events.purpose: Review readiness before the first launch
events.decision: Is the pilot ready to launch to the first group of shippers?
agenda: Present the pilot KPIs and the first target group
Review build progress and launch readiness
Confirm readiness to launch to the first group of shippers

events.label: Workshop 3: pilot results
events.purpose: Review early pilot use and scale-up options
events.decision: Which scale-up options go into the business case?
agenda: Present the launched platform and pilot use so far
Review scale-up options and their economics
Decide which options go into the business case

events.label: Go/no-go on scale-up
events.purpose: Decide on scale-up after the pilot
events.decision: Do we scale up the platform beyond the pilot on this business case?
agenda: Present pilot results against 200 active shippers
Review the business case, implementation plan and roadmap
Decide whether to scale up beyond the pilot

architect_notes: Engagement type is assumed to be assessment and implementation because of the pilot; confirm it before quoting, as it sets the Pilot phase.
The 26 weeks are split 8 for Design and 18 for Pilot as an estimate; the brief gave only the total length.
The rollout of the platform after the pilot is not in these phases; the Pilot phase ends with a scale-up business case and roadmap.
Key internal hires from the archetype's Pilot phase are dropped, because the brief does not mention hiring; confirm no hiring support is expected.
